[USER] User inquired about common VPN protocols and secure encryption options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Common VPN protocols mentioned: OpenVPN, PPTP, L2TP, IPSec, WireGuard.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] OpenVPN is considered one of the most secure VPN protocols, using SSL/TLS encryption and supporting various platforms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] PPTP is the most common VPN protocol but is not very secure due to outdated encryption methods.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] L2TP is more secure than PPTP and is often used with IPSec.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] IPSec is a strong and secure protocol but can be difficult to set up.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] WireGuard is a newer and faster VPN protocol that uses state-of-the-art cryptography.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] OpenVPN and IPSec are considered the most secure VPN protocols due to strong encryption methods and extensive testing by security experts.  
[PREFERENCE] User expressed a preference for OpenVPN due to its open-source nature and security.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated it is glad to assist the user in choosing a secure protocol and wished the user good luck and safety online.
